lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like series of high-luminance, circular spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin, decreasing in size and density towards the ventral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance spots, forming a consistent grid of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity luminance on the upper edge to deep shadow on the lower margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Multiple high-luminance blobs of varying diameters distributed across the first dorsal fin silhouette, with a higher concentration observed toward the posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable semicircular indentation or notch located on the posterior trailing edge of the visible left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Several elongated, low-luminance silhouettes consistent with commensal fish are visible along the ventral field.
